summary: terminals: execute prompts via prompt_async + model normalization

delivery.outcome: Dashboard terminal prompts actually execute: send_prompt switches to POST /session/{id}/prompt_async (the /api prompt route only steer-queues); create_session/send_prompt normalize model dicts to the server schema {id, providerID}; create_session failures surface as error dicts instead of crashing the handler; stop on an adopted-but-unpersisted instance reports the not-koru-managed refusal.
nonGoals: no changes to supervisor loop or dashboard JS
no serve-based drive lane (tillm opencode run stays the drive mechanism)

architecture.decision: prompt_async (unprefixed /session route) executes prompts on idle sessions; /api/session/{id}/prompt only steers a running loop. Server model schema is {id, providerID} — normalize caller-provided {providerID, modelID}.

validation.evidence: send_prompt posts parts[] to /session/{id}/prompt_async; model normalized to {id, providerID}; create_session HTTP error returns error dict
